name: BEA Regional Price Parities
description: Regional price parities (U.S. = 100) by state, state metropolitan and nonmetropolitan portion, and metropolitan statistical area; all items and four components
publisher: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, Regional Economic Accounts

bea_notes: Note: See the included footnote file.
SARPP: Regional price parities by state
Last updated: February 19, 2026-- new statistics for 2024; revised statistics for 2008-2023.
Note: See the included footnote file.
PARPP: Regional price parities by portion
Last updated: February 19, 2026-- new statistics for 2024; revised statistics for 2008-2023.
Note: See the included footnote file.
MARPP: Regional price parities by MSA
Last updated: February 19, 2026-- new statistics for 2024; revised statistics for 2008-2023.

method: line codes 1-5 of SARPP, PARPP and MARPP copied as published (3 decimals); pce_price_index = SAIRPD line 1 for the United States (RPP = 100, so the U.S. implicit regional price deflator equals the national PCE price index, 2017=100)
nonmetro_note: BEA nonmetropolitan portions include micropolitan counties
estimation_error_note: RPPs are estimates (CPI price quotes, ACS rents, hedonic models) with their own error, which BEA does not publish as standard errors; it is not in ACS MOEs.
